about.title: About MedMapp
about.body: MedMapp helps patients from Uzbekistan and Central Asia access trusted hospitals abroad, and helps international patients get treated at hospitals in Uzbekistan. We match you with hospitals and specialists, organise document review and second opinions, and coordinate travel — with one coordinator from the first question to follow-up at home.
